bullets.title: Is the Psychedelic Therapy Bubble About to Burst?
bullets.creator: Grace Browne for WIRED_
bullets.note: for _WIRED_. This coverage expands upon a recent paper that’s received some attention: “[Preparing for the Bursting of the Psychedelic Hype Bubble](https://www.researchgate.net/publication/363164546_Preparing_for_the_Bursting_of_the_Psychedelic_Hype_Bubble)” by [David Yaden, PhD](https://hopkinspsychedelic.org/yaden), [James B. Potash, MD](https://www.hopkinsmedicine.org/profiles/details/james-potash), and [Roland R. Griffiths, PhD](https://hopkinspsychedelic.org/griffiths), in [_JAMA Psychiatry_](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamapsychiatry/article-abstract/2795948).

bullets.title: Protekt REST
bullets.note: ([Protekt](https://protekt.com/products/rest-grape-natural-liquid-supplement-beverage-enhancer?variant=40970641965206), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/Rest-Liquid-Pack-Grape-10/dp/B08YNM17FV?ref_=ast_sto_dp&th=1)). This was given to me by a friend after I mentioned I was avoiding melatonin due to [its effects on gonadal function](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/18044344/#:~:text=Melatonin%20can%2C%20therefore%2C%20influence%20the,can%20be%20synthesized%20in%20gonads.) and next-day sluggishness. From the description: “While other sleep aids leave you groggy in the morning, we’ve chosen valerian root, theanine, and gamma-aminobutyric acid, or GABA.” Pro tip #1: If you have trouble opening the packets, just use scissors. Pro tip #2: Mix the packets with water. Do \*not\* skip that step and chug it alone. This REST cocktail has worked well for me over the last few weeks, so I plan to continue using it as part of my sleep toolkit. As with any supplement, I tend to cycle off at least 1–2 days a week.

bullets.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
bullets.creator: Ursula K
bullets.note: . First and foremost, huge thanks to everyone who [recommended their favorite novels from Ursula](https://twitter.com/tferriss/status/1558164883274960907) on Twitter. I’m now three deep, but this was my first, and it is still absolutely my favorite. This is also a favorite of [Neil Gaiman](https://tim.blog/2019/03/28/neil-gaiman/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) and countless other writers who were deeply influenced by Ursula. One could argue that without _A Wizard of Earthsea_, there is no Harry Potter or Hogwarts. Last but not least, [Rob Inglis](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rob_Inglis) is the perfect narrator for this book. To listen at faster than 1x speed would be sacrilege! Savor instead of optimizing. He also narrated the unabridged [_The_ _Lord of the Rings_](https://www.amazon.com/The-Fellowship-of-Ring-audiobook/dp/B0099SNQYG/) trilogy by [J.R.R. Tolkien](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J._R._R._Tolkien).

bullets.title: Bad Horsie
bullets.creator: Steve Vai
bullets.note: ([YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jHubmkOe-MQ), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/2W5EvgsEBmBWqZz4GumrXA?si=2304d125703a4883)) by [Steve Vai](https://www.vai.com/) ([@stevevai](https://twitter.com/stevevai)). Pair it with “[Steve Vai - Vinnie Colaiuta’s Sight Reading](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u-3vfVmy6FI),” which is hilarious. Before you watch the sight-reading video, read the following sight-reading definition [from Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sight-reading): “In music, sight-reading, also called _a prima vista_ (Italian meaning ‘at first sight’), is the practice of reading and performing a piece in a music notation that the performer has not seen or learned before. Sight-singing is used to describe a singer who is sight-reading. Both activities require the musician to play or sing the notated rhythms and pitches.” Thanks to [Dave Elitch](https://tim.blog/2018/11/26/dave-elitch/?utm_source=convertkit&utm_medium=convertkit&utm_campaign=5bf) ([@daveelitch](https://www.instagram.com/daveelitch/?hl=en)) for the video recommendation.
